about: Corrected inputs for cases whose pre-registered input did not run as the source intends, written after the first run (D950). Reported separately from the pre-registered result; the expectation is the pre-registered one.

cases.why: The pre-registered bill listed only the originating Parts A, so the check, finding every listed material originating, reported RVC 100 % and not the guide's 52 %. The guide leaves Parts B to E out on purpose; here they are listed as the build-up example gives them, with Parts B (originating in Singapore in the guide) not checked, so unknown.
